name: debo-skills
description: Official portable agent skills for Debo personal AI memory and context OS
author: Debo Contributors <team@debo.life>

skills.name: debo-agent
skills.description: Foundational operating skill for all Debo autonomous agents, enforcing editorial tone, non-LLM security, and citation rigor.

skills.name: debo-memory
skills.description: Procedural knowledge for searching, recalling, and updating personal context in Debo with strict source grounding.

skills.name: debo-connectors
skills.description: Procedural knowledge for safely executing third-party actions (Gmail, Slack, Calendar, GitHub) with human-in-the-loop approval.

skills.name: debo-workflows
skills.description: Procedural knowledge for authoring, triggering, and inspecting durable Trigger.dev background tasks in Debo.

skills.name: debo-projects
skills.description: Procedural knowledge for structuring initiatives, managing linked tasks, and recording formal architectural or strategic decisions.

skills.name: debo-research
skills.description: Procedural knowledge for conducting multi-source research investigations, synthesizing cross-document evidence, and building source timelines.
